description: Search for requests in Zendesk using query syntax. Use when you need to find customer requests across Zendesk using flexible search criteria such as status, priority, subject, or requester information. Returns paginated results with request details. This action is read-only and idempotent - searching for requests does not modify any data.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk requests.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starts at 1). Increment until results array is empty to retrieve all matching requests.
page.title: Page

query.description: The syntax and matching logic for the string is detailed in the Zendesk Support search reference. See Query basics in the Tickets API documentation. Examples: 'status:open', 'type:request', 'priority:high', 'subject:fire'
query.title: Query

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Options: 'updated_at', 'created_at', 'status', 'priority'. Defaults to sorting by relevance if not specified.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not specified.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

inputSchema.title: GetRequestsSearchRequest

name: get_requests_search

GetRequestsSearchResponse.description: Response from Zendesk requests search API.

count.title: Count
